status: REPORT_ONLY — randomized control entries only; no strategy signals, strategy trades, or strategy outcome used.

design.fallbackKey: side|verdictState|year when fewer than 100 distinct eligible fine-cell candidate bars exist in the cell-year pool
design.topUp: deterministic with-replacement random-entry draws to n=100
design.stopTargetCostsAndMaxHold: exactly RANDOM_BASELINE and existing resolveTrade baseline harness
design.devYearBoundary: candidate and all 96 possible resolving bars must remain in the same DEV year

controlCalibration.interpretation: legacyMinusYearMatchedControlDeltaR and its combined baseline sampling SE compare two random-entry controls only. They are not strategy excess and do not determine a verdict.

prospectiveExcess.reason: No strategy outcomes were run. For a future diagnostic, cell-year excess = strategy mean signed netR minus this matched random mean; excess SE must combine the strategy day-clustered variance with baseline sampling variance, including the weighted sum of per-cell-year baseline variances. DRIFT_DEPENDENT is diagnostic when year-matched excess t<=2 and is not a CONFIRMED verdict.
